tips.tip1: Some enemies love it when you stay still and can easily deal damage to you. Keep moving to confuse them.
tips.tip2: You don't have to kill every enemy. Sometimes dodging is the best strategy.
tips.tip3: Survival isn't about firepower alone. Positioning and timing matter.
tips.tip4: You can track the duration of diamond abilities just below the health bar.
tips.tip5: Some enemies become more dangerous if ignored. Eliminate them quickly. (For example UFO)
tips.tip6: UFO-type enemies can overwhelm you if you don't escape immediately.
tips.tip7: Each enemy has unique behaviors. Observing them for a short time before making your move can give you a significant advantage.
tips.tip8: There are three different types of diamonds. Each one grants unique abilities that temporarily enhance your firepower.
tips.tip9: The Green Diamond activates a Poison Attack, firing toxic projectiles that apply special effects to enemies.
tips.tip10: The Black Diamond unlocks a Critical Attack, firing slower but extremely powerful shots capable of dealing massive damage.
tips.tip11: The Blue Diamond increases firing speed and bullet velocity, allowing faster attacks with slightly increased damage.
tips.tip12: The Red Diamond boosts weapon damage significantly while keeping normal firing speed.
tips.tip13: In the Extra menu, you can learn about all in-game enemies and collectible items. You can also listen to the game's music tracks.
tips.tip14: All in-game music tracks are available in the Extra section of the Main Menu.
tips.tip15: In the Sound Settings menu, you can enable or disable in-game music, sound effects, and menu sounds.
tips.tip16: In the Options menu, you can choose joystick configurations that allow you to place the controls on either the bottom-left or bottom-right of the screen.
